title: WizCommerce pricing - Custom quote model, no published rate card
clean_text: WizCommerce does not publish a fixed pricing tier or rate card. Pricing is provided via a personalized quote process based on each prospect's needs. One add-on observed in user reviews, custom sender domain for order emails, carries a separate fee of $20 per month; this is not part of the core published pricing structure and was sourced from a customer review rather than an official rate card.

meta.pricing_model: custom quote, no published rate card
